approved_text: For N ≥ 1, let f(N) be the largest t such that there are distinct subsets A_1, …, A_t of {1, …, N} with every A_i ∩ A_j (i ≠ j) a non-empty arithmetic progression. Find an explicit g(N) with f(N) ~ g(N) as N → ∞.

source_docstrings:
Let $N\geq 1$. What is the largest $t$ such that there are
$A_1,\ldots,A_t\subseteq \{1,\ldots,N\}$ with $A_i\cap A_j$ a non-empty
arithmetic progression for all $i\neq j$?
